carpet.rule.commandPlayerTickingStage.na: Change Fake Player Tick Stage Permission
carpet.rule.commandPlayerTickingStage.de: Permission for /player <name> tickingStage, which changes a fake player's tick stage
carpet.rule.commandPlayerTickingStage.ex: true: everyone; ops: permission level 2+; false: disabled; or a minimum permission level 0-4
carpet.rule.commandPearlTrace.name: Ghost Pearl Trace Command Permission
carpet.rule.commandPearlTrace.desc: Permission for /pearltrace list/show, which inspects ghost pearl leftovers
carpet.rule.commandPearlTrace.extra.0: true: everyone; ops: permission level 2+; false: disabled; or a minimum permission level 0-4
carpet.rule.commandPearlTrace.extra.1: Command access only; recording is switched by ghostEnderPearlTrace. It must be on first for there to be records; false here just disables the command, not the recording
carpet.rule.commandPearlTracePurge.name: Ghost Pearl Purge Command Permission
carpet.rule.commandPearlTracePurge.desc: Permission for /pearltrace purge, which removes ghost pearls from online players
carpet.rule.commandPearlTracePurge.extra: true: everyone; ops: permission level 2+; false: disabled; or a minimum permission level 0-4
Command access only; recording is switched by ghostEnderPearlTrace. Purging rewrites player data, so it gets its own, tighter permission
carpet.rule.tripwireIgnoreDepartures.ext: Fixes the tripwire firing its rising edge multiple times as an entity passes through it (MC-305475), in a fairly aggressive way
carpet.rule.tripwireRestore.name: Restore Tripwire Behaviour
carpet.rule.tripwireRestore.extra.0: false: vanilla behaviour of this version
carpet.rule.tripwireRestore.extra.1: true: roll back the MC-305475 fix
carpet.rule.tripwireRestore.extra.2: 26.3: on 26.2 only, change the tripwire's 0t scheduled tick to 1t
carpet.rule.fakePlayerTicksLikeRealPlaye: Fake Players Tick Like Real Players
Make fake players tick like real players (tick moves to the network phase, action packs to the async task phase)
Per fake player, override with /player <player> tickingStage (global/invert/origin/likeReal), or the button in GCA's fake player menu
Overrides last for the current server run and reset on restart
With carpet-tis-addition installed, its machinery is used as-is and this mod only adds the per-player invert
carpet.rule.ghostEnderPearlFix.name: Ghost Ender Pearl Fix
carpet.rule.ghostEnderPearlFix.extra.0: Fixes double persistence of ender pearls caused by a thread race (MC-306936)
carpet.rule.ghostEnderPearlFix.extra.1: Hidden when carpet-igny-addition is installed; its same-name rule takes over
carpet.rule.ghostEnderPearlTrace.name: Ghost Ender Pearl Trace
carpet.rule.ghostEnderPearlTrace.desc: Forensics for ghost ender pearls: record every teleport with its source, count teleports per pearl UUID, and inspect or purge via /pearltrace
carpet.rule.shulkerBulletPortalCleanup.d: Discard a shulker bullet when it crosses a portal into another dimension
carpet.rule.shulkerBulletPortalCleanup.e: A bullet's guidance target resolves across dimensions, so after crossing it flies towards its pre-crossing coordinates
Clearing it before the teleport also spares the destination-side chunk loading
carpet.rule.shulkerBulletWeakChunkCleanu: Clear Shulker Bullets in Weakly Loaded Chunks
Trigger-style cleanup of shulker bullets sitting in weakly loaded chunks
carpet.rule.witherSkullCleanup.name: Clear Wandering Wither Skulls
carpet.rule.witherSkullCleanup.desc: Trigger-style cleanup of wither skulls and blue skulls sitting in weakly loaded chunks
carpet.rule.minecartAcceleration.name: Minecart Acceleration
carpet.rule.minecartAcceleration.extra.0: Bots can chain-mount carts and get ticked multiple times per tick
carpet.rule.minecartAcceleration.extra.1: 26.3 fixed the minecart interaction return value, giving bots a 4t use cooldown on mounting
carpet.rule.minecartAcceleration.extra.2: When on, a successful mount returns PASS again, matching pre-26.2 behaviour
carpet.rule.attributeModifierRemovalDela: [26.3+] Reintroduce MC-311022: when swapping equipment quickly, attribute modifiers are cleared a tick late
carpet.rule.mapRegistryLeakFix.name: Map Player-Record Leak Fix
carpet.rule.mapRegistryLeakFix.desc: Fix the map player-record leak caused by Lithium and similar mods
carpet.rule.mapRegistryLeakFix.extra.0: Carpet fake players are no longer added to map holder lists
carpet.rule.mapRegistryLeakFix.extra.1: The moment a player disconnects, their records are cleared from all loaded maps
carpet.rule.mapRegistryLeakFix.extra.2: Off by default; enable it when needed
carpet.rule.reloginAvatarLeakFix.name: [26.x-] Relogin Leak Fix
carpet.rule.reloginAvatarLeakFix.desc: Fix the relogin leak on Carpet-Org-Addition's 1.21.x line that keeps the old fake player in memory
carpet.rule.reloginAvatarLeakFix.extra.0: The logout task skips fake players already marked removed, so the old player's disconnect never runs and it lingers
carpet.rule.reloginAvatarLeakFix.extra.1: The disconnect is forced through while the duplicate save of an already-removed fake player is skipped
carpet.rule.reloginAvatarLeakFix.extra.2: Requires carpet-org-addition; only 1.21.2 - 1.21.11 is affected (ORG v1.46.0+ fixed itself)
carpet.rule.miningFatigueDigSpeedFix.des: [26.2-] Fix the mining fatigue III+ dig-speed table
carpet.rule.miningFatigueDigSpeedFix.ext: On 26.2 and below the hardcoded dig speed from fatigue III up has an extra zero
carpet.rule.enderDragonVerticalVelocityF: Fix the ender dragon's vertical velocity when flying to a target node (MC-272431)
Since 19w08b (1.14) the vertical acceleration scale is 0.01 (used to be 0.1), so the dragon can barely climb or dive and circles its target nodes
Restores 1.13-and-earlier ender dragon flight behaviour and also mitigates MC-271336, MC-271337 and MC-197201
carpet.rule.villagerInstantLevelUp.name: Villager Instant Level-Up
carpet.rule.villagerInstantLevelUp.desc: [26.2-] Port of the 26.3 villager trade level-up behaviour
carpet.rule.villagerInstantLevelUp.extra: With it on, a villager levels up without closing the trade screen and reprices immediately on level-up
carpet.rule.villagerLivePriceSync.name: Villager Live Price Sync
carpet.rule.villagerLivePriceSync.desc: [26.2-] Port of the 26.3 instant villager price recompute
While the trade screen is open, restock, demand catch-up, gossip spread and player reputation all reprice and correct the offers instantly
[26.1+] Babies whose growth golden dandelions can suppress steer away from golden dandelions (incl. potted, or held by a player), piglin-and-soul-fire style
Scans a 6-block radius every 20 ticks, then flees about 8-12 blocks; adults are unaffected
carpet.rule.babyMobAvoidGoldenDandelionI: [26.1+] Babies whose growth is age-locked by a golden dandelion no longer steer away from it
Requires babyMobAvoidGoldenDandelion to be on first
carpet.rule.bonemealGrowMelons.name: Bone Meal Grows the Fruit
carpet.rule.bonemealGrowMelons.desc: Bone meal on a mature (age=7) melon/pumpkin stem grows the fruit block
carpet.rule.bonemealGrowMelons.extra.0: Vanilla rejects bone meal on mature stems; when on, it becomes a valid target and fruit placement follows vanilla random-tick logic
carpet.rule.bonemealGrowMelons.extra.1: The stem needs a free horizontal spot (up to 24 random directions are tried)
carpet.rule.mapPlayerIconRotation.name: Map Player Icon Rotation
Player markers in the map always show facing; up to 26.2 an off-map player's marker shows no direction, and from 26.3 it rotates by facing too
carpet.rule.creativeNoEntityCollision.de: Creative players no longer take part in entity collision
carpet.rule.creativeNoEntityCollision.ex: Disables all entity collision whether flying or not
Projectile hits, pressure plates and other non-collision interactions are unaffected
carpet.rule.windChargeNoRedstoneActivati: Wind Charges Don't Trigger Redstone Components
Wind charge explosions no longer trigger buttons, levers, doors, trapdoors and fence gates
carpet.rule.windChargeNoBeehiveAnger.des: [1.21.2+] Wind charge explosions no longer anger nearby bees through beehives
carpet.rule.windChargeNoNonLivingKnockba: Wind Charges Don't Push Non-Living Entities
Wind charge explosions no longer knock back non-living entities
hfut.fakePlayerTickStage.stage.t: T - ticks like a real player (network phase)
hfut.fakePlayerTickStage.stage.f: F - ticks like a normal entity (entity phase)
hfut.fakePlayerTickStage.button.name: HFUT: tick stage invert
hfut.pearltrace.list.empty: No pearl teleports recorded (is ghostEnderPearlTrace on?)
hfut.pearltrace.show.last: last: %s owner=%s dim=%s pos=%s source=%s born-at=%s
hfut.pearltrace.show.no_event: no teleport recorded in the recent window
hfut.pearltrace.show.no_copies: no leftover copies in online players' collections
hfut.pearltrace.player_offline: Player not online (purge only works on online players): %s
hfut.pearltrace.purge.header: About to remove a pearl from %s: %s
hfut.pearltrace.purge.no_pending: No removal pending (or the preview expired) - run the preview without confirm first
hfut.pearltrace.purge.expired: The preview timed out (60s) - preview again, then confirm
hfut.pearltrace.purge.stale: The pearl's teleport count changed since the preview - the preview is void, run it again
carpet.rule.soulSpeedNoBootDamage.name: Soul Speed Doesn't Damage Boots
carpet.rule.soulSpeedNoBootDamage.desc: Soul Speed no longer consumes boot durability when in use
carpet.rule.durabilityRngFollowsPlayer.d: Unbreaking's durability loss roll uses the player's own random sequence instead of the world's
hfut.tradeseq.set: Reset random sequence %s and advanced %s draw(s) (state %s:%s)
carpet.rule.tradeSeqEnabled.name: Trade Sequence Control
carpet.rule.tradeSeqEnabled.desc: Enables the /tradeseq villager trade sequence control command
carpet.rule.commandTradeSeq.name: Trade Sequence Command Permission
carpet.rule.commandTradeSeq.desc: Permission for manipulating trade sequences with /tradeseq
carpet.rule.commandTradeSeq.extra.0: true: everyone; ops: permission level 2+; false: disabled; or a minimum permission level 0-4
carpet.rule.namedWanderingTraderPersiste: false = disabled; true = any custom-named trader persists; any other value = only traders named with that exact string persist
hfut.lazychunk.added: Chunk [%s, %s] is now simple lazy (block ticking only, entities frozen)
hfut.lazychunk.removed: Chunk [%s, %s] is no longer simple lazy
hfut.lazychunk.not_marked: Chunk [%s, %s] is not marked as simple lazy
hfut.lazychunk.range_added_none: Nothing to add: every chunk in that range is already simple lazy
hfut.lazychunk.range_removed_none: Nothing to remove: no chunk in that range is simple lazy
hfut.lazychunk.range_too_large: That range covers more than %s chunks
hfut.lazychunk.query_none: No chunks are marked simple lazy in this dimension
carpet.rule.commandSimpleLazyChunk.name: Simple Lazy Chunk Command Permission
carpet.rule.commandSimpleLazyChunk.desc: Permission for /hfut lazychunk, which keeps chunks loaded at block-ticking strength (entities frozen) even without players, and holds them there against promotion. In-memory: marks are lost on restart
carpet.rule.commandSimpleLazyChunk.extra: true: everyone; ops: permission level 2+; false: disabled; or a minimum permission level 0-4
hfut.lazychunk.coord_out_of_world: Chunk coordinates are outside the world (chunk x/z must be within +/-%s)
hfut.lazychunk.player_in_range: Players standing inside the mark: %s - their chunks stay entity-ticking until they leave and turn lazy the same tick
hfut.lazychunk.query_header: %s chunk(s) marked simple lazy in this dimension (page %s/%s):
hfut.lazychunk.cleared: Removed all %s simple lazy mark(s) in this dimension; affected chunks resume normal unloading
hfut.fakePlayerOpen.player_only: Only players can open this interface
hfut.fakePlayerOpen.online: %s is currently online - open their live interface instead
hfut.fakePlayerOpen.in_use: %s's storage is already being viewed by %s
hfut.fakePlayerOpen.no_server: The editor is not available yet
carpet.rule.commandFakePlayerOpenStorage: Allows /player <player> open inventory|enderchest to open GCA's fake player interface for editing while the fake player is offline; edits are written back when the menu closes, and also force-flushed before the player joins or the server stops, preventing item duplication. Requires Carpet GugleCarpetAddition; without it the rule does not exist
true: everyone; ops: permission level 2+; false: disabled; or a minimum permission level 0-4
